government_structure: Federal. Surveyed at the federal level only. The federal government delivers directly: social security retirement/disability/SSI (SSA), federal tax (IRS), immigration benefits (USCIS, field offices and service centers), veterans' benefits (VA/VBA), Medicare (CMS), patents/trademarks (USPTO), passports (State/Consular Affairs), federal student aid (FSA), small-business loans (SBA), disaster assistance (FEMA), federal workers' compensation (OWCP), railroad retirement (RRB), pension insurance (PBGC), customs (CBP). States deliver unemployment insurance ('There is no federal unemployment program', usa.gov/unemployment-benefits), vital records (CDC NCHS: 'The federal government does not distribute certificates'), business entity formation (SBA: 'Most states require you to register with the Secretary of State'), Medicaid and SNAP (state agencies under federal CMS/FNS rules; FNS and Medicaid pages returned 403/404 so the split is backed here only by the DOL ETA/FNS instruction series found) and driver licensing. Federal registrations for firms: EIN (IRS), BOI (FinCEN), trademarks (USPTO).
web_languages: Spanish (partial: usa.gov/es, uscis.gov/es, IRS publications in several languages)

proactive_publication_duties: 552(a)(1): publish in the Federal Register descriptions of organization, where and how the public may obtain information or make requests, 'the general course and method by which its functions are channeled and determined', 'rules of procedure, descriptions of forms available or the places at which forms may be obtained', substantive rules and statements of general policy

552(a)(2): make available electronically final opinions and orders in adjudicated cases, statements of policy and interpretations not published in the FR, 'administrative staff manuals and instructions to staff that affect a member of the public', frequently requested records (requested 3+ times), and an index of these

internal_guidance_practice: Systematic and legally driven: 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(2) obliges agencies to publish 'administrative staff manuals and instructions to staff that affect a member of the public', and the largest service agencies do so as enumerable online manuals. SSA: Program Operations Manual System (POMS) on secure.ssa.gov/apps10/poms.nsf, the field-office/DDS staff manual organised Part > Chapter > Subchapter > Section with transmittal numbers and effective dates (e.g. DI 11005.001 'Field Office Disability Interviews', TN 134 05-26, instructs interviewers to review MBR, SSID, DDSQ, HACPS and ARPS queries); parts include SM 'Systems and Methods', MS 'Modernized System Operations Manual' and DX 'Data Exchange', i.e. descriptions of what the case systems do; HALLEX (hearing and Appeals Council procedures, now renumbered HA 01xxx within POMS, e.g. HA 01280.020 'Decision Writing Instructions' TN I-2-267 01-06-2025); Emergency Messages and Chief Judge Bulletins are also listed. IRS: Internal Revenue Manual (Parts 1-39) in HTML per section plus a directory of ZIP source files per section (irs.gov/downloads/irm, e.g. irm03-012-003r.zip), stated to be provided to meet E-FOIA. USCIS: Policy Manual (12 volumes, 'USCIS officers are expected to follow it', Volume 1 Part E Adjudications with chapters on Evidence, Discretionary Analysis, Rendering a Decision, Post-Decision Actions, current as of 2026-10-27), replacing the Adjudicator's Field Manual (retired 2020; crosswalk and remaining AFM PDFs; old AFM URL now 404), plus Credible/Reasonable Fear Procedures Manuals in the reading room. VA: M21-1 Adjudication Procedures Manual is published via the KnowVA knowledge base (JavaScript-only; could not be read here) and a 2016 Federal Register notice 2016-06257 'Web Automated Reference Material System' (FR API) documents the public access. CMS: Internet-Only Manuals (100-01 to 100-25, e.g. 100-04 Medicare Claims Processing Manual, 39 chapters as PDF; 100-08 Program Integrity Manual; 100-07 State Operations Manual) with yearly transmittal listings. DOL OWCP: FECA Procedure Manual Part 2 (claims adjudication, development, payment, case management, appeals, 'automated systems'). USPTO: MPEP (9th ed. rev. 01.2024, HTML/PDF/zip). SBA: SOP 50 10 v8.1 (7(a)/504 loan origination, DOCX). OPM: CSRS/FERS Handbook (47 chapters for agency personnel/payroll offices). Education/FSA: FSA Handbook (web and PDF, 1995-96 to 2026-27). EOIR: Policy Manual (court/Board practice manuals, OPPMs, docketing manual). FEMA: Public Assistance Program and Policy Guide and other policies. DOL ETA advisories (TEGL/UIPL to state agencies), FNS SNAP guidance, HUD handbooks, State Department FAM/FAH, SSA forms and rulings pages could not be opened (403/404/503/JS) and are recorded as open questions. Automation descriptions: POMS SM/MS parts and FECA 'automated systems' chapters are the only system-level descriptions found; no agency publishes automation rates.

internal_guidance_examples.name: POMS - Program Operations Manual System (SSA)
internal_guidance_examples.note: Enumerable Domino views: partlist, chapterlist!openview&restricttocategory=NN, subchapterlist, section URLs lnx/0411005001 (DI 11005.001). Parts: RM, GN, RS, DI, SI, HI, SM (Systems and Methods), NL (Notices), PM, QR, VB, PR/PS (legal opinion precedents), SL, MS (Modernized System Operations Manual), DX (Data Exchange). DI part lists ~50 chapters; DI 110 subchapter list alone has 247 entries. Also hosts HALLEX (HA), Emergency Messages, Chief Judge Bulletins and POMS Archives. www.ssa.gov is Akamai-blocked for automated clients; secure.ssa.gov answers.

layer_scores.reason: No national procedure register. USA.gov is a topic directory with links; the Benefit Finder (benefits.gov now redirects to it) returns program lists with 'how to apply' links but no structured steps, deadlines, fees or legal basis fields, and no API or export was found. The PRA inventory on reginfo.gov is a structured register of forms, not of services.

Consolidated in-force texts with APIs: eCFR versioner API serves point-in-time XML of any CFR section (opened 20 CFR 404.1520) with structure and version endpoints, up to date as of 2026-10-29; US Code consolidated through P.L. 119-136 (2026-10-22); Federal Register JSON API; govinfo bulk XML for CFR, FR, ECFR, PLAW, STATUTE, COMPS. Caveat: uscode.house.gov download pages 404 ('temporary format') and federalregister.gov HTML pages redirect automated clients to an unblock page.

Detailed per-service guidance for the main agencies, enumerable and partly bilingual: USCIS all-forms listing (105 forms, each with purpose, instructions and online filing) and Policy Manual with Spanish nodes; IRS forms-and-publications library (3,137 items, sortable, paginated); USA.gov EN/ES topic pages; VA forms search; PBGC, RRB service pages; VA publishes a BVA sitemap XML. SSA public guidance pages could not be opened (403) and are not counted.

Forms libraries for the main agencies: IRS (3,137 PDF forms/publications), USCIS (105 forms with PDF, instructions, ~21 filed online), GSA Standard/Optional Forms library, VA find-forms; government-wide PRA inventory on reginfo.gov with OMB control numbers, form numbers and burden data and an ICR XML reports page. No machine-readable field definitions found (IRS MeF schemas not checked); SSA forms page 403.

FOIA 552(a)(2) requires publication of staff manuals, and the main agencies publish them as enumerable repositories: SSA POMS (Domino views by part/chapter/subchapter/section with transmittals; includes SM/MS system-operation parts and HALLEX), IRS IRM (HTML per section plus ZIP source-file directory), USCIS Policy Manual and reading-room procedures manuals (2,061 entries), CMS IOMs with transmittals, DOL FECA Procedure Manual, USPTO MPEP, SBA SOP 50 10, OPM CSRS/FERS Handbook, FSA Handbook, EOIR Policy Manual, FEMA PAPPG. VA M21-1 exists on KnowVA but is JavaScript-only and unread.

Open data on cases and outcomes: SSA monthly initial-disability processing-time CSV (CC0) and DDS workload data on data.gov; USCIS quarterly XLSX per form with receipts, approvals, denials, pending and processing time plus monthly CSV; IRS Data Book XLSX (returns, examinations, appeals, service); VBA Annual Benefits Report; DOL UI dashboard (timeliness, nonmonetary determinations); FOIA.gov XML. Automation rates: not found anywhere.

Searchable full-text databases of appeal-board and court decisions: BVA decisions as plain-text files at predictable URLs (opened A26031219, 2026-04-06), AAO 169,839 non-precedent decisions, BIA precedents, Tax Court DAWSON, MSPB, NLRB, and CourtListener API for federal courts. Not 3 because the largest benefit adjudicator (SSA ALJ/Appeals Council) publishes no decisions (only aggregate counts), there is no general ombudsman and the CIS Ombudsman publishes no case outcomes, HHS DAB/Medicare Appeals Council pages were 403, and government bulk access is limited to sitemaps/data.gov records.
